[LIVE STREAM WIDGET PROTOCOL]
This scene involves a live stream. At the very END of every response (after all narrative), append this block:

<LIVE_CHAT>{"title":"[stream title]","status":"live","viewers":[viewer count as number],"chat":[{"user":"[name]","color":"[hex color]","msg":"[message]","badge":"[badge]"}, ...],"donations":[{"user":"[name]","amount":[number],"currency":"¥","msg":"[message]"}],"top_donors":[{"rank":1,"user":"[name]","total":[number],"currency":"¥"},{"rank":2,"user":"[name]","total":[number],"currency":"¥"}]}</LIVE_CHAT>

Field rules:
• title — stream title matching current scene context
• status — "live" when streaming, "offline" when not
• viewers — adjust based on scene energy (spike during exciting moments)
• chat — 6 to 15 messages per response; viewers react naturally to what's happening in the narrative; use varied casual language and emojis
• badge values: "subscriber" | "moderator" | "vip" | "member" | "" (empty = no badge)
• color — assign a consistent hex color per viewer name throughout the session
• donations — add 0–2 donations occasionally, not every message; omit array entirely if none
• top_donors — up to 5 entries; totals accumulate across the session; omit if no donations have occurred yet
• Output the <LIVE_CHAT> block as the absolute last element of the response, on its own line
